title: bib — BPASS-in-Browser
description:
A pedagogical web explorer and REST API for BPASS (Binary Population and Spectral Synthesis) simple-stellar-population products: interactive SEDs, photon-weighted synthetic AB photometry through SVO filter curves, screen dust extinction within each law's validity window, redshifting with flat ΛCDM distances, and optional IGM attenuation (Inoue et al. 2014; Madau 1995), with per-filter flags stating what was applied.

bib serves derived BPASS products under the BPASS team's CC BY-NC 4.0 licence with attribution; the software itself is MIT licensed.
